proposals.evidence: DEDR1173 explicitly gives Kannada gaṇḍa husband, gaṇḍu male and gaṇḍasu/gaṇḍusu male person, dialect geṇḍa husband. These survey gaṇḍ-/geṇḍ-/kaṇḍ- forms retain that male/husband family with ordinary endings and source consonants; Sanskrit gaṇḍa is a comparison in the article, not an established immediate donor for these records. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
